recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle medium shot of two men standing in a grassy field under a bright, cloudy sky. The man on the left wears a wide-brimmed felt hat and a light denim shirt with patchwork details; the man on the right wears a brown baseball cap and a camouflage windbreaker. The composition features a clean geometric sans-serif title at the top and a large, expressive hand-lettered title centered between the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two subjects framing the central text
Contrast between the structured top font and the organic central lettering
Harmonious earth tones in clothing against a desaturated blue and white sky
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature and openness
coreInvariants: Bright, diffused natural lighting with soft shadows
Desaturated color palette dominated by tan, denim blue, and olive green
Text placement that utilizes the negative space of the sky

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in the lower two-thirds of the frame, positioned left and right of the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central hand-lettered text acts as the primary focal point between the two men.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top geometric text, drop to the central script, then move outward to the two subjects' faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of cloudy sky in the upper third provides a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale blue and white (sky) providing a neutral backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Earthy browns and tans (hats, lettering, grass) providing warmth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Olive green and denim blue (clothing) adding depth and texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high brightness, creating a 'washed-out' but clear aesthetic.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid deep blacks; use dark browns or navy for shadows

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Uniform stroke weight, wide tracking, open counters.
Central text: Variable stroke width, slanted axis, rough 'dry brush' edges, interlocking glyphs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the script is often elongated and tilted.
Ascenders and descenders in the script are exaggerated to fill vertical space.

composition.overlap: Overlaps sky and slightly touches subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing: A rigid, modern sans-serif paired with a loose, energetic organic script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text
The earthy brown color of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, wide geometric uppercase aesthetic.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Custom brush script or 'Wild Youth' font
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, hand-painted energy of the central title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of two men in a field of tall dry grass. The man on the left wears a tan wide-brimmed hat and a light blue denim shirt. The man on the right wears a brown cap and a green camouflage jacket. The background is a bright, overcast sky with soft white clouds. Desaturated, warm color grading.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of wide-spaced, thin white geometric sans-serif text at the very top. In the center, between the two men, add a large three-line title in a textured, hand-drawn brown script, slightly tilted.

verificationChecks: Is the top text perfectly centered and widely tracked?
Does the script text have a visible dry-brush texture?
Is the color of the script sampled from the brown tones in the hats?
Is the horizon line low in the frame?

adjustableVariables: Specific patchwork patterns on the denim shirt
The exact angle of the script tilt
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing
The exact facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the clouds.
Check that the subjects' poses feel relaxed and candid.
Verify the color harmony between the brown text and the brown accessories.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle outdoor duo portrait with a dual-font typographic system: one clean/geometric for metadata and one expressive/hand-drawn for the main title.
